--- title: "ETF3231/5231 Business Forecasting" page-layout: full --- Business Forecasting focuses on practical forecasting workflows with R, from first visual diagnostics through ETS, ARIMA, and regression-based models. The site is organised the same way as the week-to-week teaching: use the current-week panel to get oriented, then drop into the relevant week page for readings, seminar slides, activities, and assessment reminders. ## This week
This week

Week 6 · Exponential smoothing

Extend ETS to handle seasonality and automatic model selection using the AICc.

Prepare before class

Read Sections 8.3 to 8.7 of FPP3 with attention to seasonal ETS structure and automatic selection.

Seminar and workshop

Wednesday 15 April · Seminar 3:00pm to 3:50pm, workshop 4:00pm to 4:50pm · Building K Level 3, K321

Key focus
  • Seasonal exponential smoothing
  • ETS model classes
  • Automatic model selection with the AICc
Assessment

GA2 on Tuesday 14 April · Week 6 quiz on Wednesday 15 April

Coming up next: Week 7 starts 22 Apr: ARIMA models

::: ## Learning outcomes ::: {.outcome-grid}
01

Diagnose the main features of time series data using graphics, decomposition, and residual analysis.

02

Build and compare forecasting models ranging from benchmark methods to ETS and ARIMA families.

03

Use predictors, regression structure, and dynamic regression to improve forecasts when extra information is available.

04

Communicate forecasts clearly in Quarto-based analytical reports and reproducible R workflows.

Every group member has the right to express concern/dislike in terms of a group member being absent from group activities. This has to be expressed directly to me (and only me) via a formal email stating facts that have hindered the operations of the group (saying I do not like George because he is tall is not a reason for expressing concern). If at least two such complaints are submitted during the completion of an assignment, the group member concerned will receive a warning. If the situation is not improved during the next assignment and another two complaints are again submitted, the group member will be immediately removed from the group and will be expected to complete the rest of the group assignments alone. ::: ## Install the R packages Use the following once if you need the core packages for the semester. ```r install.packages(c("tidyverse","fpp3", "GGally"), dependencies = TRUE) ```
